payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

My costs on ISSUE-0001 tasks are very high, so I'd like to avoid those unless needed to increase tasks_done. Please coordinate around that and share your intended picks.

ISSUE-0002::implement is feasible by availability but expensive (cost 19.00). All ISSUE-0001 tasks are much more expensive for me (triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40), so I prefer ISSUE-0002 work. Since Mona already prefers ISSUE-0002::review at lower cost 7.44, I currently lean to ISSUE-0002::test as my tentative choice, with ISSUE-0002::review only as backup if needed. Please share intended picks to avoid duplication. (phase=planning, iter=1)
